full_page.content:
Page 134
St. Anthony - Sacred Heart - Corpus
Jun. 14 Joseph Pfeifer - 50 - estranged from widowed Mother
Jun. 16 Francis Whalen - 25 - brain trouble -"decay of tissues. Seems in- telligent but memory seems going - lost a brother with same thing a few yrs. ago - and Mother.
Dennis Barrette- 43 - arthritis in neck and head. cold 12 yrs. ago in shop ..... doctoring ever since ....
Page 135 June 18th Fred. Apel - 20 - very nerveous - fears crowds - cannot go in cars C & C - Enrolled To-day (annual) promises perp.
Nicholas Vass - 28 - Very peculiar weakness in hip and knee - joints - Drs. puzzled ..... Enrolled 1.00
Thomas n. Cath. Ward - he 76 - has had two strokes ... blind in one eye Edmund J. Meurer - 40 - bone - T.B. of bone; has been away more
Beryl Willits - 25 - has been for years indifferent in practic of re- ligion, now preparing to marry before a minister (lutheran)
Frances Amata - 31 - blood-poison - has little baby three weeks old ... Mrs. Sullivan at 222 Marlborough - wants girl ... Lenox 1735 Mrs. Ceclia Hanlon - 44 - Eye trouble - Glucoma Henry Bolan - 38 - Lutheran - in Sweeden - T.B. Sarah Mussman - 27 - Stomach up-side-down - 6 yrs.
Page 136 June 28
Rita Martin - 17 - bad case of Eczima - sorosis ever since birth Anne Pozybylski - 32 - broken back and fractured scul eleven years ago. Can walk but very poorly ..... Enrolled To-day 1.00
Dr. J. P. Thomas - 40 - colored - blood clot on brain & in Coma since last Sunday.
Marie Laramie - 31 - nerveous - had operation - very peculiar ....
